prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original hand-painted HUD status icon for a 2D industrial mining fantasy action game, one single icon on genuine transparent alpha.
Subject: BURN status: a bold upward orange flame tongue embracing one faceted lump of coal-black anthracite, dark copper seam at its base. Exactly two to three bold shape groups; an instantly readable rising flame silhouette.
Style: elegant original hand-painted game icon, softly painted bevels, restrained painterly charcoal steel and aged dark copper with ember-orange mineral focal color; tactile mining material; sophisticated understated light. Designed to remain unmistakable at 24 to 32 pixels. Large smooth shapes, a little material texture, no fussy microdetail.
Composition: centered single isolated icon, square canvas, full object visible with generous clear transparent margins (about 16 percent on every side), no cast shadow outside the icon.
Constraints: actual transparent background, no frame, no surrounding badge, no scene, no floor, no background glow, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no glossy candy-like mobile game rendering, no recognizable existing franchise design.

qa.visual: Original upward flame with coal and copper, distinct compact rising silhouette, no text or badge.
qa.alpha: Pixel alpha verified separately in tool output.

alpha_scan.note: Strict transparent_background_verified requires every border pixel exactly zero; a false result may indicate faint generator residuals. Preserve original generated pixels and inspect border_max_alpha; no code cleanup performed.
